definitions.explanation: Bite-sized pieces of chicken (and sometimes other meats or vegetables) skewered and grilled over charcoal.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{鳥|とり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頼|たの}みました→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.notes: 塩 (salt) vs タレ (sauce) are the two main flavoring options

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{鳥|とり}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦やろう→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: Let's have a drink at a yakitori place.
examples.notes: 一杯やる is a casual expression for having drinks

examples.japanese: ⟦ねぎま→ねぎま：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{焼|や}き{鳥|とり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Negima is a standard yakitori item.
examples.notes: ねぎま is chicken alternated with green onion

examples.japanese: ⟦{炭火|すみび}→炭火：25320_sumibi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧{焼|や}き{鳥|とり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Yakitori grilled over charcoal has a great aroma.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦{帰|がえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焼|や}き{鳥|とり}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}って→寄る：02440_yoru⟧、⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}みながら→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{焼|や}き{鳥|とり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つまんだ→つまむ：10374_tsumamu⟧。
examples.english: On the way home from work, I stopped by the yakitori place in front of the station with a colleague and snacked on yakitori while drinking beer.

notes:
Popular yakitori cuts:
- ⟦もも→もも：28095_momo⟧ (thigh)
- ⟦むね→むね：00972_mune⟧ (breast)
- ⟦ささみ→ささみ：noentry⟧ (tenderloin)
- ⟦かわ→皮：02187_kawa⟧ (skin)
- ⟦つくね→つくね：noentry⟧ (chicken meatball)
- ⟦ぼんじり→ぼんじり：noentry⟧ (tail)
- ⟦はつ→はつ：noentry⟧ (heart)
- ⟦レバー→レバー：11263_rebaa⟧ (liver)
- ⟦{砂|すな}ずり→砂ずり：noentry⟧/⟦{砂肝|すなぎも}→砂肝：noentry⟧ (gizzard)
- ⟦ねぎま→ねぎま：noentry⟧ (chicken with green onion)

Flavoring options:
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt)
- ⟦タレ→タレ：10500_tare⟧ (sweet soy-based sauce)

Yakitori is a casual, affordable food often enjoyed with beer at {焼|や}き{鳥|とり}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ or ⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧ (food stalls). Counter: ⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧, ⟦{二本|にほん}→二本：noentry⟧...
